scenes.title: Your first listing, from start to share
scenes.narration: Welcome to Rendprop. This guide walks through one complete listing: enter the home, capture photos, review optional edits, make a video, publish the website, and follow up with buyers.
steps: One home keeps the work together
You can leave while AI work continues

scenes.title: Five tabs keep work organized
scenes.narration: The bottom bar has Home, Listings, Activity, Leads, and Account. Home starts new work. Listings holds each property. Activity tracks jobs. Leads holds enquiries. Account contains your profile, settings, and plan.

scenes.title: Sign in, then explore
scenes.narration: Sign in with Apple and finish the short introduction. Exploring the app does not start a free trial. A trial begins only if Apple offers it, you confirm the subscription, and Rendprop verifies it.

scenes.title: Start in Listings
scenes.narration: Open Listings and add the property before making media. The listing is the folder for its original photos, saved edits, videos, website, contact choice, and buyer enquiries.
steps: Return to this listing for every later step

scenes.title: Enter the real address
scenes.narration: Enter the home address carefully. Confirm the map suggestion when it is right, then add only facts you know, such as beds, baths, and square feet. An address can be edited before publishing.

scenes.title: Choose who buyers contact
scenes.narration: Open Who should buyers contact? Use your own contact card or select the client’s details when appropriate. Check the visible name, email, and phone before publishing so leads reach the right person.

scenes.title: Plan a simple photo route
scenes.narration: Start outside if you have a clear front-of-home photo. Then photograph entry, living area, kitchen, bedrooms, baths, and the best outdoor spaces. A short, deliberate set is easier to review than many near-duplicates.
steps: One clear view per useful angle

scenes.title: Record a walkthrough only if useful
scenes.narration: Drone-style walkthrough is optional. You can record in the app or upload an existing clip. Move slowly and smoothly, keep the phone level, and avoid quick turns. The photo-based listing video is a separate feature.

scenes.title: Add the original photos
scenes.narration: In the listing toolbox, open Photos. Tap Add photos or Take a photo. Import keeps the original source, so you can compare every later version and return to the untouched image.
steps: Add photos or Take a photo

scenes.title: Capture for a clean result
scenes.narration: Use natural light, hold the phone level, and shoot landscape for the website and listing video. Use the point-five lens only when the room needs it. Avoid cutting off walls or important fixtures.

scenes.title: Open Photo versions
scenes.narration: Tap a photo to inspect its saved versions. Switch between Original, Latest, Decluttered, and Staged when available. The selected listing version is a choice; creating an edit does not silently replace every photo.
steps: Choose the version used on the listing

scenes.title: Use AI Photo Studio selectively
scenes.narration: From an original, tap the wand or Edit originals with AI. Choose declutter, staging, sky, or another available edit. Check the credit or plan allowance shown before you start; each selected photo may use AI processing.

scenes.title: Review edits for truthfulness
scenes.narration: Open the result beside its source. Check windows, doors, walls, fixtures, and room proportions. A staged room should not invent permanent features. Save only edits you would feel comfortable showing a buyer.

scenes.title: Set the gallery and cover
scenes.narration: Tap a photo’s listing control to use that saved version, or use Select All within a filtered group when the whole set is right. Choose a strong cover and review gallery order before publishing.
steps: Use on listing, or Select All

scenes.title: Export the right photo copies
scenes.narration: Photos can be shared as originals or prepared copies. Export photos offers organized versions and destination choices. Check your MLS image rules before sending files; website copies are not a substitute for the retained originals.

scenes.title: Open Make a video
scenes.narration: Back in the toolbox, tap Make a video. This uses your selected photos to create a downloadable listing or social video. It does not require a recorded walkthrough. Start with only the strongest reviewed images.

scenes.title: Choose the photos in order
scenes.narration: On Choose your photos, tap images in the sequence viewers should see. The numbered tiles show the exact saved versions. Change filters if you need originals or finished edits. Nothing is generated on this screen.
steps: Use the saved version you reviewed

scenes.title: Set the screen shape
scenes.narration: Choose the look next. Wide makes a landscape listing video; Tall makes a vertical social video. Pick the destination before checking crop, because the same photo fits differently in each shape.
steps: Preview the crop for that shape

scenes.title: Tune motion and timing
scenes.narration: Choose Photo motion for a controlled move over each still, or an available AI camera option. Set time on each photo: a simple entrance can be brief; important rooms can hold longer. Preview framing before creating.

scenes.title: Check the framing review
scenes.narration: Framing review shows the start and end crop. Watch for trimmed ceilings, doorways, or important details. If a photo does not fit the format, change the photo or shape before you spend usage on the video.
steps: Change photos if the crop fails

scenes.title: Add sound only when it helps
scenes.narration: On the review screen, open Voice and music. Music, narration, and large words are optional. Preview sound, then pause it before continuing if needed. A clean silent video is valid for many listing uses.
steps: Leave them off for a silent export

scenes.title: Create, leave, and return
scenes.narration: Review the selected photos, timing, and any credit quote. Tap Make my video once. Processing may take several minutes; you can leave the screen. Activity keeps the job under the right property.

scenes.title: Watch before you use it
scenes.narration: When Activity says Ready, open the finished video. Check smoothness, crop, scene order, and sound. Save to Photos or Share for MLS or social delivery. Tap Use on listing website only after you approve the full video.
steps: Use on listing website, Save, or Share

scenes.title: Aerial intro starts outside
scenes.narration: Aerial intro is an optional AI opening shot, not captured drone footage. Use an original photo showing the whole front and actual roof. Review the crop, processing terms, and credit quote before making the opening.
steps: Keep roof and entrance in frame

scenes.title: Accept an opening only if it works
scenes.narration: Watch the saved aerial clip and check motion, roof shape, and the path toward the entrance. Use as the opening only if you accept it. When selected, it plays first; the following photo order stays intact.

scenes.title: Tag a recorded walkthrough
scenes.narration: For a separate recorded walkthrough, tag rooms at the moments they appear. These become tap-to-jump chapters on the property experience. Re-render refreshes that recording; it does not replace the photo-based listing video.

scenes.title: Choose the website design
scenes.narration: Open Website design from the listing. Classic is the included design with paid access. Signature Estate and Coastal Luxe are optional property-specific upgrades when available. Preview a sample without publishing your draft.

scenes.title: Review before publishing
scenes.narration: Check the gallery cover, approved listing video, property facts, address, and buyer contact. The website uses the video you chose as its opening hero. If you accepted an aerial opening and included it in that video, it plays first on the website too. A recorded walkthrough remains separate.
steps: Selected hero video · accepted aerial first

scenes.title: Publish, then share the link
scenes.narration: Tap Publish listing when the review is complete. Your address-based share link includes a unique publication identifier, so a later agent can publish the same address without taking your page. Use Copy, QR, or Share your link.
steps: Buyers open it without the app

scenes.title: Use the right MLS link
scenes.narration: The listing also offers an unbranded MLS link. Check your local MLS rules before using it. Keep the agent-branded share link for your own marketing, and confirm the published page on a browser before sending it broadly.

scenes.title: Leads stay with the property
scenes.narration: Open Leads to see enquiries grouped by listing. Follow up from the actual buyer request, and verify the contact method you chose. A listing's website can collect enquiries while you work elsewhere in the app.

scenes.title: Activity is the job dashboard
scenes.narration: Activity groups work as Active, Ready, Needs attention, and History. Search for a property when you have many jobs. Open a row to return to its listing. When completed work can be counted, the app shows a percentage; otherwise it says Progress not reported instead of guessing.

scenes.title: Recover without starting over
scenes.narration: If a job needs attention, open its listing and read the specific status before retrying. Do not repeatedly tap Create or buy credits again. Saved photos and requests remain attached to the home; use the offered recovery control.
steps: Use the specific Retry or Review action

scenes.title: Account holds your tools
scenes.narration: Open Account for Profile and contact card, then Settings and plan. Settings includes your app walkthrough, team management when available, account data, and support paths. Ask AI can explain the screen you are on.

scenes.title: Understand the trial and plans
scenes.narration: Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team are monthly plans. Check Apple's current price, included access, and any eligible seven-day offer before confirming. The limited trial supports one listing and limited photo edits; video and website publishing need paid access. If paid access is missing, select the original workspace and tap Restore purchases in Settings before buying again.

scenes.title: Credits are separate from the plan
scenes.narration: Credits and extra usage shows the shared workspace balance, monthly and purchased portions, and available top-ups. Purchased credits do not expire. The app shows a job's credit cost when spending is available. If a top-up is missing, tap Check pending purchase before buying again.

scenes.title: Work with a team carefully
scenes.narration: Team workspaces share listing work and one credit balance. Owners or admins manage eligible purchases and invitations; seat availability depends on the current subscription. Check which workspace is selected before buying or editing a shared property.

scenes.title: One last review, then share
scenes.narration: That is the practical path: accurate home details, clean originals, reviewed edits, a video you have watched, the right contact card, and a published website. Floor plans and three-dimensional capture are later features, not part of this first release.
steps: Publish and open the live link
